metadata.title: Pygame Minesweeper
metadata.description: Basic 10×10 single-player Minesweeper: source-compatible first-click mine relocation, zero flood, flags, question marks and timer.

variables.name: Mine positions and adjacent counts (-2 mine, 0–8 safe)
Display state (0 covered, 1 flag, 2 question, 3 revealed, 4 exposed mine, 5 incorrect flag, 6 detonated mine)
60 Hz timer ticks since first opening
Cell to open after first-click preparation

actions.name: Left click a questioned cell to remove its question mark
Right click: covered → flag → question → covered

systems.name: Open selected cell and recursively expose zero region including numbered boundary
Reveal unflagged mines and incorrectly flagged safe cells on loss
Advance timer only after opening and before completion

random_streams.name: Random mine positions and first-click relocation

assumptions: Coordinates use the source's [row,column] indexing. A player release on a question-mark cell removes the question mark without opening it; flags are not opened directly. Timer ticks approximate the source's wall-clock seconds at the source's 60 FPS.
